name: Participant Release and Waiver of Liability
description: A customer-event participant’s assumption of risk, release, indemnity and medical authorization for an optional activity, with emergency contact, photo consent and a parent or guardian for a minor.

governing_law.description: Written after "the laws of": for example, the State of Delaware, or England and Wales

body.title: PARTICIPANT RELEASE AND WAIVER OF LIABILITY

body.p: Activity: **{{activity}}**, on {{date}}, an optional activity offered to guests of {{event}}, organized by Fontara, Inc. ("Fontara").
Participant name: [[text:Participant:Participant name]]  Date of birth: [[text:Participant:Date of birth]]
Signing as: [[radio:Participant:Signing as:The participant (18 or older)|Parent or legal guardian of a minor participant]]
I understand the activity involves risks, including physical injury and damage to property, and I voluntarily assume them.
[[check:Participant:Understands the risks]] I have read this release and understand the risks.

I release Fontara, its affiliates, employees and agents, the activity provider and the venue operator from claims arising from participation in the activity, except claims caused by their gross negligence or willful misconduct.
I will indemnify Fontara against any claim by a third party arising from the participant's own negligent or wrongful conduct during the activity.

I authorize Fontara and the activity provider to obtain emergency medical treatment for the participant if they reasonably believe it is needed and I cannot be reached, and I am responsible for its cost.
Name: [[text:Participant:Emergency contact name]]  Phone: [[text:Participant:Emergency contact phone]]
Photo consent: [[radio:Participant:Media consent:I consent to Fontara using photos of the participant from the event|I do not consent to photos]]
This release is governed by the laws of {{governing_law}}, and is intended to be as broad and inclusive as those laws allow. If any part of it is held unenforceable, the rest remains in effect.

then.p: The participant is under 18. I am the participant’s parent or legal guardian; I give this release, indemnity and authorization on the participant’s behalf and on my own, and I consent to the participant’s taking part.

body.p: Signature of the participant, or of a parent or legal guardian if the participant is a minor:
